name: OpenVibe.Codes

site.name: Codes
site.tagline: Build and fix apps with AI
site.what: The open coding-agent harness: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Command Code, the DeepSeek API and self-hosted models behind one router with hand-offs, sessions and budgets, OpenVibe Git (a code forge with OpenVibe sign-in at git.openvibe.codes) and the way to improve OpenVibe itself.

faq.question: What is OpenVibe.Codes?
faq.answer: An open harness for coding agents: it runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Command Code and DeepSeek-backed agents on your tasks, with hand-offs between them and a review by a second model.

faq.question: Can it run on my own machine?
faq.answer: Yes. With OpenVibe.Run and the OpenVibe node on your computer, a task can run on your own hardware instead of a server.

faq.question: Where is the code?
faq.answer: On GitHub under OpenVibers, open source like the rest of OpenVibe, with read mirrors on OpenVibe Git at git.openvibe.codes.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

resumes.what: signed-in visitors keep their session cookies (verified offline against Network's JWKS); nothing else is pending: the harness catalog is read from the release at boot

codes.task.* rows not yet published are sent by the relay after a restart under their fixed evt_ ids; run.job.* deliveries missed while down are redelivered by OpenVibe.Events and claimed once in codes_events_inbox

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies
blockers: the trust table was rebuilt once to the ADR-013 tier names (server/db.js maps the old values): a release from before it expects the old tier names

leases.none: no claims: one process owns the ov_codes PostgreSQL database; writes are transactions there

notes: Port 4900, unit openvibe-codes.service. The open coding-agent harness (owner 2026-10-08): the harness catalog and router (GET /api/v1/harnesses, POST /api/v1/harnesses/route), the way to improve OpenVibe (contributing, code of conduct, the contributor ladder) and permanent redirects from the former developer-portal paths to openvibe.services, where the portal moved (manifests, releases, trust, playgrounds, docs, OAuth and webhook tools). Coding tasks on the person's own machine (plan T16) are Run jobs: their sessions are kept line by line in codes_session_lines as the stream arrives (back-filled from the machine's final log; GET /run/tasks/:id/session.json replays them), run.job.* events from OpenVibe.Run finalize a task without polling, and every state change is published as codes.task.queued|running|succeeded|failed|cancelled from a transactional outbox.
